map.1:1 表示成像与实物等大。: 1:1 means image and subject are the same size.
map.由放大率求物体在传感器占比。: Find the subject coverage on the sensor from magnification.
map.判能否完整拍下小物体。: Decide if a small subject fits fully.
map.M=0.5×、传感器高 24mm：物体像高 = 12mm，占传感器 50%；可拍: M=0.5x, sensor height 24mm: image height = 12mm, 50% of sensor; largest subject = 24/0.5 = 48mm fills the frame.
map.想拍 30mm 昆虫满幅：需 M = 24/30 = 0.8×，镜头若仅 0.5: To fill-frame a 30mm insect you need M = 24/30 = 0.8x; if the lens only does 0.5x, move closer or add close-up.
map.占比和放大率关系？: How do coverage and magnification relate?
map.像高=物高×M，占比=像高/传感器尺寸；M 越大占比越大、可拍物体越小。: Image height = subject height x M, coverage = image height / sensor size; larger M means more coverage and smaller shootable subject.
map.同 M 下大传感器能容更大物体满幅，故中画幅微距视角更广。: At same M, a larger sensor fits a bigger subject full-frame, so medium format macros see wider.
